about.title: A School Born to Reveal Every Child's Genius
about.mission: Founded in Nkozoa and accredited by MINEDUB, the Bilingual School Complex Les Génies d'Afrique was born from a deep conviction: every child carries exceptional potential. Our mission is to reveal it, nurture it and prepare them to excel in a globalised world.
about.vision: We aspire to become the bilingual school of reference in Cameroon, recognised for the quality of our guidance, the innovation of our teaching methods and the holistic development of our students.
about.values: Excellence, integrity, bilingualism and care form the foundation of our educational project. Every pedagogical decision is guided by the well-being and progress of each child entrusted to us.
about.bilingual: Our fully bilingual approach — French and English from day care — is far more than an advantage: it is an opening to two cultural worlds, a springboard to the best academic and professional opportunities.
about.excellence: From school farming to junior entrepreneurship, we go beyond official programmes to shape complete, creative and responsible individuals. Because tomorrow's leaders are shaped today.

timeline.title: The Founding Vision
timeline.description: The Bilingual School Complex Les Génies d'Afrique is founded in Nkozoa, Yaoundé, with a clear vision: to reveal the genius within every child through bilingual, holistic education.

timeline.title: MINEDUB Accreditation
timeline.description: The school receives official accreditation from the Ministry of Basic Education (MINEDUB), confirming compliance with Cameroonian educational standards.

timeline.title: Opening of Both Sections

timeline.title: Growth and Expansion
timeline.description: The school community grows to over 120 students, launches 6 extracurricular clubs, and establishes itself as a bilingual school of reference in the region.

founderMessage.title: A Word from the Founder
founderMessage.quoteOpen: Every child is born a genius waiting to be revealed.
founderMessage.message: The dream that led to the creation of Les Génies d'Afrique is above all a dream of hope. Having worked for years in education, I have seen too many children whose talents go unnoticed, confined by rigid systems that do not always take the time to see each child as an individual with unique potential.
founderMessage.body: At Les Génies d'Afrique, we have built an environment where every child can blossom — an environment where excellence rhymes with well-being, where rigour goes hand in hand with joy of learning, where French and English open doors to two cultures and two futures. This is our promise to you.

hero.title: Two Linguistic Paths, One Shared Excellence
hero.subtitle: From Day Care to Primary, our French and English sections offer a complete bilingual education aligned with MINEDUB standards, enriched by innovative pedagogical projects.

intro.title: A Complete Bilingual Journey
intro.body: At Les Génies d'Afrique, every student benefits from a fully bilingual educational journey. Whether in the French or English section, French and English are taught daily from the earliest age, opening the door to two linguistic and cultural worlds. Our enhanced curricula go beyond official programmes to include school farming, entrepreneurship, arts, and sports.

levels.title: Day Care (0–2 years)
levels.presentation: A warm, secure, and loving environment where our youngest children take their first steps in a community that values awakening, sensory discovery, and individual care. Each child evolves at their own pace under the watchful eye of qualified early childhood professionals.
curriculum: First language experiences in French and English
objectives: Ensure the physical and emotional security of each child
Develop first motor and cognitive skills
Introduce the joy of discovery and learning

levels.title: Nursery School (2–5 years)
levels.presentation: Nursery school is a crucial stage where children consolidate their learning foundations and prepare for primary education. Our bilingual approach immerses them daily in French and English through playful, structured activities designed to stimulate curiosity and develop social skills.
curriculum: Pre-reading and pre-writing in both languages
Awakening to the world around us
objectives: Build solid foundations in reading and counting
Develop oral fluency in French and English
Prepare children for a successful entry into primary school

levels.title: Primary School (5–11 years)
levels.presentation: Primary school at Les Génies d'Afrique offers two parallel sections — Francophone and Anglophone — both following the official MINEDUB curricula. Students benefit from enhanced programmes, intensive bilingual teaching, and innovative projects to develop critical thinking, creativity, and a love of learning.
objectives: Ensure mastery of fundamental knowledge and skills
Develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills
Achieve fluency in both French and English
Prepare students for successful entry into secondary school
Shape responsible, creative, and autonomous citizens

sections.title: Our Two Linguistic Sections
sections.subtitle: Two complementary paths, one shared ambition: to shape bilingual, fulfilled, and successful students.

frenchSection.title: Francophone Programme
frenchSection.subtitle: Day Care → CM2 (2–11 years)
frenchSection.body: The French section follows the official curricula of the Cameroonian Ministry of Basic Education, enriched with complementary educational content and progressive English immersion from Day Care. Our teaching is rigorous, caring, and stimulating. It prepares students for the success of the First School Leaving Certificate (CFEE) and admission to the best secondary schools.
keyPoints: Emphasis on sciences, mathematics, and expression

englishSection.title: Anglophone Programme
englishSection.subtitle: Nursery → Class 6 (2–11 years)
englishSection.body: The English section offers a rigorous curriculum fully aligned with MINEDUB guidelines. Teaching is conducted primarily in English, with French as a strong second language. Students benefit from a rich literary and scientific education that prepares them for the First School Leaving Certificate (FSLC) and the best secondary schools in Cameroon and abroad.
keyPoints: French as a strong second language
Focus on English literacy and numeracy

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions most frequently asked by families.

items.question: What is the minimum registration age?
items.answer: The minimum admission age is 2 years completed for entry into Nursery. Our Day Care welcomes children from birth to 2 years old. Exceptions can be considered on a case-by-case basis after an interview with the principal.

items.question: My child does not speak English, can they join the French section?
items.answer: Absolutely! Bilingualism is progressively introduced. In the French section, English is taught as a second language from Grade 1 (4 hours/week). A catch-up programme is offered to new students according to their level.

items.question: What are the school hours?
items.answer: Classes are held Monday to Friday, from 7:45 AM to 3:00 PM for Nursery and until 4:00 PM for Primary. Morning reception is open from 7:00 AM and after-school care is available until 5:30 PM on request.

items.question: Is there a school cafeteria service?
items.answer: Yes, a cafeteria service is available for all students. Meals are balanced, prepared on site and adapted to children's needs. Menu displayed weekly. Half-board or packed lunch options available.

items.question: Do you offer a school transport service?
items.answer: A transport service is organised according to geographical areas (Nkozoa and its surroundings: Cité-Verte, Mvan, Mokolo, etc.). Schedules and rates are communicated at registration. Limited number of places, on a first-come first-served basis.

items.question: How are the school fees structured?
items.answer: Fees are broken down into: registration fees (once a year), tuition fees (quarterly or annually with a discount), and miscellaneous fees (canteen, transport, uniforms, materials). A detailed and transparent fee schedule is given to every family during the visit.

items.title: Farming & Livestock Club

items.title: Junior Entrepreneurship Club

items.title: Contests & Competitions
